nom: No7 Radiance+ 15% Vitamin C Face Serum

avis.texte: Somehow this ends up on my lips, and tastes horrible. It's not moisturizing. It feels like it sits on top of my skin, like a plastic layer My search for perfect vit C serum

The serum had a nice, pleasant scent, but unfortunately it didn't work well for my skin. After applying it, the formula left my face feeling sticky, and once it dried, it created a white, flaky residue that peeled around my skin. Because of that, I ended up returning it. It just didn't perform the way I expected from a Vitamin C serum.

I didn't think it was possible for a fairly run-of-the-mill vit. C to break me out this badly. Magically transformed my tendency towards hormonal acne into two weeks of deep, painful cysts. Will this happen to you? Probably not. Smells great.

I've tried a lot of Vitamin C products and wanted to try something more affordable. Surprisingly, this was a great product and I'll continue to purchase again. I like the consistency and it gives my skin a brighter glow.

avis.titre: Bright, Glowy Skin in Just Days!
avis.texte: I've been using the No7 Radiance+ Vitamin C Serum for a few weeks now, and I can already see such a difference in my skin. The formula feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. My complexion looks brighter, more even, and just has that healthy glow I've been looking for. What I love most is how gentle it is—some vitamin C serums can be harsh or irritating, but this one works beautifully without any dryness. It layers really well under my moisturizer and makeup, so it's become a must-have in my morning routine. If you're looking for a serum that delivers visible radiance and helps your skin look refreshed and energized, I can't recommend this enough. It's definitely earned a permanent spot on my skincare shelf!

I've been using the No7 Radiance+ Vitamin C Serum for a few weeks now, and I can honestly say my skin has never looked brighter or healthier. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving no sticky residue, which makes it perfect to layer under my moisturizer and makeup. Within days, I noticed a fresher, more even-toned complexion and a natural glow that feels like I finally "woke up" my skin. I love that it delivers the power of vitamin C without irritation—my skin feels smoother, looks more radiant, and I've even gotten compliments on how refreshed I look. The packaging also keeps the serum fresh and is super easy to use. This serum has become a must-have in my morning routine—I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a boost of brightness and healthier-looking skin!

A little of this amazing serum goes a long way. I have been using this serum for a couple of months now and it really has improved my skin! It does feel a little bit sticky a first, but that does not last after you apply the moisturizer.

avis.titre: Affordable, High Quality 15% Vitamin C Serum
avis.texte: I LOVE No7's Radiance+ 15% Vitamin C Face Serum!! This is such an affordable, high quality option. 15% is a high concentration of Vitamin C, so I know I'm getting the best brightening and anti-aging benefits. I actually alternate between this serum and my Skinceuticals C E Ferulic vitamin C serum (the gold standard). Skinceuticals is a bit (a lot) pricey, so I incorporate this affordable Vitamin C into my routine every other morning. I notice an immediate glow when using this product!
I've used Radiance+ vitamin C serum for more than year. I've found it to be more effective than higher priced serums.

I was using another Vitamin C serum which I am no longer able to purchase at Ulta. I have not been using this product for an extended period of time, but so far I like this product. I can't say I notice any improvement as to fine lines and such but I like the feel of the serum. It applies well and I feel it perks me up.
This serum is very sticky and tacky on my skin. I had to return it.

When i first applied it I thought it had potential. Even with the stickiness I thought it might double as a primer. The stickiness turned into an awful gummy pilling mess with the rest of my skincare. I had to remove all my skincare and start over. Im glad i removed it because my skin was getting warm and red. I can't imagine how it would have been if I left it on.

I have tried several Vitamin C serums, & I really enjoy this one from NO.7. I haven't gotten breakouts, see brightening of my skin, & have such a suppleness to the texture of my skin. I recommend washing face & neck with a mild liquid or cream cleanser, toning the skin, & then after applying eye cream, adding the Vitamin C serum! Perfect for hyperpigmentation & uneven skin tone. Keep trying until you find your perfect day & night-time skin routine.
I do feel it is helping even my skin tone. A bit sticky but I like the product overall.

avis.titre: I would buy this again cause it really works
avis.texte: I love this product I put it on morning and night it' toned up my face and under my eyes

This says it's 15%. No results. I respond INSTANTLY to Vitamin C. My skin always glows w. it. My Vitamin C was discontinued and I am still searching for a strong one. They use some WEAK strange form of vitamin C that equivalent to crap. DO NOT BUY.

I have purchased this product several times over the past 15 months or so. It seems like it has made a difference in my skin. A couple of years back during my yearly skin examination the Physicans Assistant at the dermatologist office said my skin would benefit from using retinol at night and vitamin c in the morning. I purchased an expensive brand there,it was maybe $115. That's not in my budget for buying often,but No.7 vitamin c serum is- I honestly cannot tell the difference between the two products. My 79 year old mother is also using it now and loves it also.

avis.titre: Definitely in the skin care routine now
avis.texte: I purchased this after reading about the benefits of vitamin c and I'm not disappointed. Great price and a great product and I will continue this in my daily routine.

I've been looking for a vitamin C because they say it is imperative to use in the morning if you use retinol at night and I'm already on my second bottle. It is so great. I love how well it dries on the skin. It does seem a bit sticky, but you just have to be patient and let it dry before applying your moisturizer. It's definitely not great if you're in a rush, and trying to get out the door fast since it does take about five minutes to dry but once it dries, it feels so good on the skin. It smells amazing. I'm so glad I found this product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!!
avis.texte: This product has been nice so far. My skin is a combo and with spring around the corner, this is the right vitamin c I need.
Really like this so far. It has only been a week so major changes that I've noticed.
The consistency was very sticky and it didn't feel like it was absorbing into my skin. Had to return.

avis.titre: It works! But the serum is.onnthe sticky side
avis.texte: Used the entire bottle. I hated that it's on the sticky side . But it absorbed well and most importantly faded dark spots and brightened my skin. On pure results of the product this has been better than Vichy, CeraVe, Mad Hippie and Olay.

avis.titre: Used whole bottle prior to review
avis.texte: I always check reviews before buying but my phone had no service while in Ulta. So I bought this as I've had good results with vitamin C products. Then I got home and looked at some poor reviews! Oh well, I'm stuck using it now, I thought. Yes, it's sticky, but only while applying. It seems to sit on face rather than get absorbed, but guess what? I absolutely love it! I think it forms a magnificent barrier that keeps moisture in. Baby soft skin in the mornings! No breakouts. My skin is very dry. I used both am and pm.

I tried this as a more affordable vitamin C serum since I wasn't seeing results with my expensive one. Majorly regret it. After 2 weeks I developed a red rash around my mouth and nose (perioral dermatitis), flakes, and bumps. I did a patch test and didn't have a result, this was a buildup over 2 weeks of using the product in the morning. I don't have sensitive skin at all so I really wasn't expecting this, even at 15%. Still trying to get it to go away weeks later. Also, it pilled underneath my Your Skin But Better CC cream no matter how long I let it dry. I'm going back to the pricey stuff I guess.
I have areas of discoloration on my face from a chemical burn and within a week, I can tell a huge difference. The glow this serum adds to the skin is great!

I am not an expert on skin care and I saw a bunch of videos of girls that never seem to count the drops when putting on their serum so I did the same. It says only 3-4 drops for the entire face and I put a bunch.. so it didn't end well,i tested on my forearm after putting it on my face and it got a little red, i think is too strong. I read a little after this incident and it says that they don't recommend anything above 10% of vitamin C and this serum has 15% so sometimes more is not better. I will be returning this soon for sure.

I purchased this vitamin c serum because I've been wanting to add vit c to my skincare routine and didn't want to get something too expensive. This stuff leaves my skin feeling sticky + broke me out after using it for less than a week. It's the only change I've made to my skincare routine. I stopped using it a few days ago and my skin is already improving. I will be returning this.
I just started using this product, as I am aging and trying to prevent it. I have nothing to compare it to. I do feel like it's sticky and sits on my skin. My skin does have a glow to it.
This is great! Gives my aging skin a glow and a look of fullness! Love it!

truth be told i ve only used this for a week soi cant comment on the brightening aspect. The consistency is sticky which i thought would be good for a base for makeup but ive come to realize that this is the culprit to my newly pilling make up. On more than one occasion ive pilled which is frustrating. I can use this at night but that not the time frame i wanted it for. The citrus smell will keep you using it because it makes you think its really handling business, maybe it is but the pilling is a no for me.

I've used many other serums including ones with vitamin c but this has 15% and you can tell as skin is noticeably brighter after even one use. Doesn't irritate my skin, which is pretty sensitive. Lower priced and just as effective as some much higher priced products. Highly recommend
Pills under makeup and caused a horrible reaction on my skin. Im a seasoned vitamin c user and this is bar far the worst i have evwr tried.

Leaves my skin really sticky and I have a lot of dark spots from sun damage and after about a month of daily use I literally see no difference. Plus it doesn't layer well and will pill when i add my sunscreen and foundation on top. I won't repurchase and probably won't even finish this bottle.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I have been using this product for over a month now and I can see the difference.
I will be returning this product-developed a severe allergic reaction-very red, ichy and burning feeling all over my face! Beware, has alot of bad ingredients in it.
This caused painful contact dermatitis after one use. It must be to strong for my skin.

I read nothing but good reviews and even asked the people at ulta, they said they "never heard anything bad about this product," but, clearly I'm not the only reviewer in agreement, my face is insanely sticky. I'm returning this product.

Test on a small spot before using it. My face still stings. It is so painful and uncomfortable. I have never reacted to anything. I will never buy anything from this brand again. Please do yourself a favor and test before applying it on your face. I wouldn't wish this on my worse enemy. I am taking this bottle to my dermatologist and asking him what can be in this bottle that can give me such nasty chemical burns. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT.

I really wanted this to work it has great reviews abs price was just right however I'm super sensitive and this brought my skin to a big mess. First started out with hives then red and white small bumps to chapped horribly under my lips and on my chin. I'm also on say 4 of swollen eye lids sooo sad. I'm gonna try to return them and go back to Mad Hippie.
I've never had a reaction to any product.. my skin can handle anything but this product gave me a chemical burn all over my face. I've never had hives like this. Never again.

I love the No7 Rad Plus Percent VITc Concentrate! It feels good on my skin and makes it look and feel refreshed and smoother. I don't like the application with the dropper, but other than that I enjoy this product!

avis.titre: Sticky, had slight rash the next day
avis.texte: At first application, the consistency was good, but after rubbing it in, it became really tacky. Immediately afterward, certain spots on my face got itchy, although I was able to tolerate it reasonably well. But I couldn't handle the stickiness, which didn't go away even after an hour. I can't imagine layering this under something else. Also, it has a scent to it. Although the scent is pleasant (citrus), I prefer my serums to be fragrance free. I'll probably try it again (maybe use a little less), but will likely use at night, when the stickiness is less of an issue.

avis.titre: It doesn't smell stinks but still works effectively
avis.texte: This Vitamin C serum doesn't stink like most other Vitamin C serums. It smells fresh and pleasant. It has a clear light yellow gel-like texture. It's lightweight, fast absorbing, and doesn't feel sticky. It does give very mild tingling, like all other Vitamin C serum products. It's not harsh on my skin, but it still gives you results. My skin appears brighter and more radiant after a few weeks of usage. My skin is smoother, and my dark spots lighten. If you want to try Vitamin C serum and don't like the stinky smell, you'll love this serum. Worth trying and recommended!

I was amazing with the brightening of my skin after using this product consistently. I was able to see my dark spots from previous acne go away. My skin was left glowing. I put the product on at night and use moisturizer over it.

I love introducing my skin to products that will make it look and feel better. This vitamin C serum makes my skin look super glowy and healthy after I apply it. The dropper is very good and you only need a bit for your whole face.

I absolutely love this serum right away my skin looked so healthy and brighter more glowy (in the best way possible). After continued use I've noticed a big difference overall my skin looks more even, radiant and just healthy.
I've been using this daily since a received it and I love the way it makes my skin feel. I also believe it has helped with dark circles

Vitamin C is a must have in a skincare routine. This one is great value for the price, did not irritate my skin and absorbed fast. Always follow with moisturizer and sunscreen. Results take a while but once you see them you won't go back! My sun spots are fading and skin is showing far less texture. Great product.
I absolutely love it, dries quick. Works great! Everyone needs some of this. I will be using this religiously moving forward as I am very happy and impressed with this product.
I received this complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion. I really enjoyed this serum. Its not sticky, doesn't stink and really brightens.
I would not say that this serum will give you brighter and glowing skin as the product claims but it might after some use. It can be used both AM and PM and is good for all skin types.
Pleasantly surprised. Much thicker than any other vitamin C serum. Nice, not too strong scent.

The No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate serum actually surpassed my expectations. I have used many serums throughout the years, but none have left an impression like this one. It actually does what it promises. My skin care routine suffered dearly over the past couple of years and my skin was looking dull and sad, even after diligently keeping up with it. After three weeks of consistent use, this serum has calmed the redness and begun evening my overall skintone. Even smoothing out the texture of fine lines and wrinkles. It's not too heavy, greasy, or sticky, and has a soft, pleasant citrus scent. The No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate is a great product for the drugstore price and availability. I will continue to use it in my daily routine as long as I continue to see the great results.

avis.titre: Nice serum, doesn't have a strong scent.
avis.texte: I like that it doesn't have that super strong smell like some vitamin c serums do. It's lightweight, glides on easy and leaves my skin with a glow after using. However, if a moisturizer isn't applied over it, it does have a sticky feeling for quite a while. I've noticed my dark spots are lighter and my skin feels smoother and looks healthier. Overall, it's a great vitamin c serum for the price!

avis.titre: Did not see a positive result.
avis.texte: I tried this as directed and have not notices any changes for the better on my dark spots or complexion on my skin. It separates my makeup and instead of making it smoother tiny pimple like bumps appeared all over my face. I do have acne prone and oily skin and did not help it but made it worse.

Just in the short period of time that I have been using this serum, my face is glowing and radiant. I use it in the morning so the sun will help with the vitamin c in it. I absolutely LOVE this serum and will be purchasing it in the future.
No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate 25ml Is an awesome product . Helped brighten my skin

Number 7 skincare products have never failed me. I love the price point and the availability they have at the drugstores. This vitamin c is quite effective and strong. Leaves skin a little tacky after application but once it dries you don't feel it much which is good for layering. I tried it under makeup but it pilled so i can't use it with that but for the most part i can use it my nighttime routine just fine. Overall I'm happy with the product.

I liked this No.7 Rad Plus 15 Percent Vitamin C Concentrate that I received free from Bzzagent in exchange for my honest review. I liked the consistency of the product and it absorbed into the skin easily when I applied once a day. It has the slightest citrus that is barely there. This brightens and enlivens the skin quickly. It seems to work well.

I don't stay in the sun a lot, so wearing a vitamin C serum during the day works for me. I also enjoy using it at night as part of my nightly routine. I have used serums in the past that are vitamin C based that dry my skin out. This was different! It has a very smooth, moisturizing consistency. I notice that my face is brighter! I will definitely be purchasing this again.
I barely just use two drops (anymore and it begins to feel sticky) rub over entire face. I have noticed my complexion is brighter and smoother.
I have been using it since a month now… it has increased the glow and reduced the dark spots on my skin… my skin feels and looks fresher than ever

One of the purest and most effective vitamins C that I tried on my face. I love the texture that the smell leaves on my skin and even the taste is vitamin C, which I do not dislike. I love the excellent results with the blemish texture and that shine that it leaves on my skin
I've used other vitamin C serums, but the No.7 Vitamin C serum makes my skin have this "glow from within" that others have not! My makeup looks so much more radiant and my skin just feels healthier.

This was my first time using anything from this brand so I really wasn't sure what to expect, so I started out with a spot test first just to make sure that it wouldn't irritate my skin. I use it daily with my nighttime routine and I was really impressed with how quickly I began to see results. At the end of the first week I noticed that my skin was so much brighter, my skin tone was more even and it was a lot smoother and I also personally love the light citrus scent. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate 25ml
avis.texte: The No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate has brightened my under eye circles and evened out my skin tone!
Truly a new staple in my skincare routine. Made me feel like my skin was plumper and smoother. I received this item complimentary and all opinions are my own.

avis.titre: Good product for a fair price
avis.texte: I like this vitamin C serum. 4 stars because I don't love the dropper mechanism. When Vitamin C is exposed to air it can expire faster so I tend to lean towards vitamin C serums that have a closed air dispense system. It seems to be a good quality serum though so I do like it and would re-purchase. From what I know once vitamin C is exposed to air you have a couple months before it fully goes bad so as long as you are using this up every month or two I don't think you have anything to worry about.

avis.titre: Good product for a fair price
avis.texte: I like this vitamin C serum. 4 stars because I don't love the dropper mechanism. When Vitamin C is exposed to air it can expire faster so I tend to lean towards vitamin C serums that have a closed air dispense system. It seems to be a good quality serum though so I do like it and would re-purchase. From what I know once vitamin C is exposed to air you have a couple months before it fully goes bad so as long as you are using this up every month or two I don't think you have anything to worry about.

Honestly it was a lot like any drugstore vitamin c product . There wasn't anything different about it and it worked the same as drugstore brands. It has a sticky residue when you apply it and leaves your face feeling a little sticky . My head started hurting when I used it idk if it was the smell or why but I am not very sensitive to smells . I honestly wouldn't buy this product or recommend it since there are a lot of vitamin c products that work the same or work better.

I did not like this product very much. The ingredients were great but it was so sticky. I hated the feeling on my skin and my lotion didn't sit correctly on top of it. I did not see any change in my skin either. I was hoping it would work great because of the ingredients, but it was a total bust for me.

I love this product. I have been a fan of No7 products for quite a while now. I was super excited to be able to try this. It left my skin look revitalized and refreshed. My skin soaked up the vitamin c and I felt like my summer skin was back. Constant use of this product has helped my skin look more healthy and summer moisturized!

I know they say vitamin C is essential in a skincare routine but I've tried a few serums and I was not impressed. I was skeptical trying this. It has a gel like texture that is tacky upon application but absorbs quickly. I have been using this serum for almost three weeks and I have noticed that my skin looks a bit brighter and more radiant. Nothing drastic though. I haven't seen any improvement in skin texture or tone as it claims. This serum does layer well under makeup, giving a luminous dewy finish which I am not a fan of. Overall I think it's a decent Vit C serum.

I am 43 and I have always been pretty proactive about wearing sunscreen, especially on my face. I do have some sunspots around my eye area, on my temples and on my hands. I have a rather large one on my right temple that I really have been focusing on. I have been applying No7 the Radiance+ once daily before my moisturizer in the morning. First thing I noticed right out of the bottle is the amazing scent. I don't care for heavily scented products, but this is very light and pleasant. It's a great price for the size and a little goes a long way. It has a nice texture when smoothing it on the skin and the slight stickiness goes away if you let it set for a minute or two before applying moisturizer. I can already see a difference in the spots on my face, especially the larger one on my temple, and my skin feels very soft. I am going to start working on some of the spots of my hands and expect to see similar results.

avis.titre: No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate
avis.texte: I always use a Vitamin C serum each day. I have tried various serums and lotions containing Vitamin C. I have had positive results overall with this Vitamin C serum from No7. My skin temporarily feels taught immediately after application and I notice a healthier appearance. I did not experience irritation or redness. The slight citrus fragrance is pleasant. I am able to use my makeup foundation over the top of this serum without issue. I unfortunately notice a slick tacky stickiness on my fingers after application of the serum to my face. I like the bottle appearance and the dropper functions as it should. I have been satisfied with No7 products that I have tried in the past. This C serum is a good quality for this price range.

No7's Radiance+ 15% Vitamin C Serum comes in a glass jar with a dropper. The instructions say to use ¾ of a drop. Being a low-key person, I round up to the nearest drop. The texture is a slightly viscous liquid that spreads easily without dripping. Avoid your lips and eyes. The serum has a pleasant citrus scent that isn't overpowering. I noticed a glowing appearance—no pregnancy required. My skin didn't react in an adverse way. I would buy this product and recommend it to friends and family since it lives up to its claims including providing a dewy glow, having a lightweight gel texture and citrus scent, and being gentle on skin. While some results will take consistent use, vitamin C is known to control acne and oil, increase collagen production, even out skin tone, tighten pores, contain antioxidants, and moisturize.

I really like this bottle and the dropper as it dispenses just the proper amount and doesn't waste any. It does go on a tad sticky at first but then that disappeared as it absorbs. Best thing is that my skin definitely looks smoother, healthier and even younger. It has a nice citrusy fragrance that is very very lght and non-irritating at all. Just a natural scent.

I usually used vitamin C on morning, but si have rosacea so not every Vitamin C is good for my skin, mostly vitamin c are strong for my skin. But when I used this my skin tolerates it very well. Have a good vitamin c concentration. It's an excellent option for rosacea skin.

It's a good serum, I feel like it's gentle on the skin while doing its job,In the first use the skin feels hydrated, with constant use it begins to feel clearer and softer What I do suggest is not to use around the lips because the serum runs off and tends to stay on the lips and has a bitter taste.It is the only thing, in general it is a very good product.

To start, I am mid 30s with combo skin and live in a hot, humid state. I have very mild rosacea so I love a good Vit C serum to combat the redness I have on my checks. I have used a TON of high priced and drug store versions and this is my fav so far. I saw a difference after only a couple days of use - less redness and more smoothness to my face. With higher concentrated versions, my skin has burned before - but not with this product! It also dried very quickly and not sticky at all which was super helpful in completing my daily routine. Bonus - no smell which was nice. I would def purchase this again.

No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate 25ml comes in a nice size bottle packed with VitC brilliance and soothing serum! I've been using it for almost 3 weeks now and you can see the obvious brightening efficacy it has on my skin (see pictures). I use it once a day - in the evenings after my usual washing and cleansing routine. It has a nice consistency and super fast absorbency. I pair it with my usual moisturizer or sometimes light facial oil. In the morning upon waking up, my face looks and feels so supple. The VitC serum does magic overnight. I think keeping it as part of my evening skin care will do me great good in the long run. Definitely recommend!

I generally avoid daily vitamin c application due to the skin drying effects of a previous brand used. My experience using No7's serum is much better! The daily glow they advertise is very subtle, but I do see a definite change in skin texture and color after using consistently for 28 days. I no longer have a red patch of skin on my cheeks! It's non-drying or irritated. It also absorbs quickly, not leaving a tacky feeling behind. Highly recommend!

I've really been enjoying this one, especially since the weather started to change. It's helped keep my skin refreshed and soft. It's light weight and doesn't leave a sticky feeling or film behind. It goes on nicely and soaks in quickly. My skin feels softer and brighter since using it. I have semi sensitive skin and it has been super gentle. The only problem I've had is if I get it too close to my eyes, then the skin tingles. So I just avoid that area. I will definitely continue using this one and plan to get more from this line soon. It's great!

The first thing that caught my eye about this serum was the size of my bottle! It's a very generous ml size, as most of my other serums are smaller. The scent is very light and reminiscent of oranges. The actual serum is very tacky, Usually my serums are very thin, this one actually had some body to it. It absorbed nicely and I followed it up with my normal skincare and makeup routine. The first day I wore it, a coworker did compliment my skin and told me "I was glowing" so that was definitely some positive reinforcement. This serum is a great value for it's size and I cant wait to experience more results from it

I've been using this product for a couple of weeks now and I haven't really noticed a difference. I was hoping it would help my dark spots fade but I'm not noticing anything different. I will continue to finish up the product to see if there will be a change in the coming weeks. The results compare to other similar products - no results. I'm disappointed right now but am hopeful to see changes. I've read it takes up to 3 months until you see results so we'll see.
I liked this serum. It goes on smoothly, without being greasy or feeling heavy. It's now apart of my morning and night skin care routine.

I absolutely love this serum and the positive results it has on my face. I have dark puffy eyes and really needed some help. I use just a few drops on my face and it has helped me so much. It isn't sticky at all and my face feels so good with it. I have been getting lots of compliments already, so yes, this is a win for me! I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to try it.

No 7 Radiance + Vitain C brought my skin back to life, it's like lemonade on a summer day! Within a few uses my skin felt more vibrant, more firm, provided brightness that I am lacking because of enlarged pores and help minimize them giving the look of a tighter younger skin. It smells amazing, very citric and refreshing, gives a very fresh look. I definitely need two pumps of product because one only made it to half my face but it is a big bottle so I'm happy.
Amazing product amazing quality and texture!!!! I love it helps my skin looks soft and radiant and beautiful I love it!

This Vitamin C serum is great because it's helped bring life back to my dull complexion. I use a few drops on my face and neck at night before applying moisturizer. It has a nice, light citrus scent, and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin feeling greasy or tacky. I love how much brighter and dewy my skin is.

The No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate 25ml is one of the best, if not the best vitamin c concentrate for skincare! I noticed a huge difference in my skin after a week. It was smoother and less red. I have tried a lot of products to help with redness from acne and acne scarring and this No7 concentrate really worked! I would definitely purchase it and recommend to anyone looking to step up their skincare game!

I love this serum concentrate. It makes my skin glow instantly, plus I feel like it has made my skin glow in the month that I've been using it. One of the few vitamin c products that did not irritate my skin, also.

I was able to try NO 7 Radiance Vitamin C serum and it's amazing. This is my first experience with NO 7 and I'm highly satisfied with the quality of this product. It's very easy to use and leaves my skin looking fresh and alive. I love how it helps and prevent with any hyperpigmentation. I would highly recommend this product to everyone. It's different from anything I own because it's the highest percentage Vitamin C in my skincare collection at the moment. Great product and great results.

I really like it when serums have multi functions like this one. It works to help your skins texture and complexion. It is light and like most serums with vitamin c it does help brighten your skin uneven discoloration. The price is also not bad.

I'm so happy that BzzAgent sent me this for free in exchange for my honest review. The N°7 Radiance Plus 15% Vitamin C serum is more like a Vitamin C facial oil than a serum which I enjoyed because it not only did what it promised and left my skin with a brighter, healthier look but it left my skin looking and feeling hydrated as well. It's a thin formula, slightly citrus scented, but it doesn't linger long. It absorbed into my skin easily and despite feeling like a facial oil it didn't make my skin feel greasy, oily or sticky. I noticed a big difference in how healthy my skin looked, it had a glow, even my husband noticed it. It worked well with my other skincare and under makeup. It didn't cause any irritation or break outs. I am definitely going to keep using this as a permanent part of my skincare routine and I highly recommend it.

I received this serum in return for leaving a review. It had a very orange-y smell & went on sticky - just like I imagine orange juice would. After I let it sit for a few minutes, it absorbed pretty well. I didn't see any changes in dark spots or notice a glow from using this product. Most of the benefit for me was knowing that Vitamin C is good for my skin, so in that way, I would say this met the goal - my skin doing look drastically different, but it didn't seem to hurt. The price is not too bad for a Vitamin C serum, too.
Nice texture. Not sticky like other vitamin C products. Noticed my skin is visibly brighter after the first week!

I received the No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate from Bzzagent to review. After reading the ingredients and looking up information on the brand in general I was really excited to try this product! This product went on really nice and felt great on my skin. After using for about a week I started to notice my skin was soft and glowy. I am honestly looking forward to continuing to use this as part of my regular routine and see more results!

I have been wanting to try a new vitamin C-type of serum and I was excited that I had the opportunity to test out this one. The main benefits of vitamin C serums consist of: skin brightening, evening out skintone, reducing redness, and hydration. When you first dispense it into your hand and rub your hands together to warm it up, it feels kind of sticky even after you apply it to your face. I apply by rubbing it all over my face and then going back and patting my all over my face to make sure the serum gets in to the skin. I used this every morning after cleaning my face, cleaning with an exfoliating toner, then applied the vitamin C concentrate. Followed by moisturizer and sunscreen. I did notice a difference in my skin. My skin looks brighter and the hormonal acne that I did get around my chin went away faster than normal. My face appears more "awake". I will definitely keep using this as my go-to!

I was really looking forward to seeing the results of this product . I liked that the scent wasn't too strong and the it wasn't too sticky on it was applied on the face. But it gave me cystic acne. I haven't had cystic acne in so many years. I would no be recommending this product.

I really loved this product. My face was very dull and didn't have much color. After using this after just a week I could see such a difference. It made my face look and feel brighter. I definitely recommend this product!
What I think about this product is I love it! Works great on my skin. My skin is super bright and soft. It works great with combination skin. I use it daily.

Used every other day in the morning because I didn't want my sensitive skin to get irritated. It's thick so I only used one drop for my entire face I Pat it into my skin l love the smell and definitely gives me that morning glow
I really like this serum. I definitely noticed my skin looking a little more bright and much less. Still. It absorbs quickly after putting it on, does not leave my face feeling sticky

avis.titre: No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of different vitamin C serums, and this one is as good, if not better than, the rest. The bottle is pretty and makes it feel more high-end. I would definitely purchase again.
I've been using this serum every night before I go to bed as part of my night time skin routine. I feel like my skin looks smoother and some of my dark spots have faded. It has worked well for me.
This was my first experience with this product and I must say I will be a returning customer. The product does all that it says and I could not be happier.
I really love the vitamin c serum. My face is noticeable brighter & glowing. I like the way it hydrates my skin as well.

I absolutely love the way this feels on my face in the morning. It's great to "wake up your skin" in the mornings. Smells fantastic as well. With light application you can see the difference in your face than without.
Been using it for a few weeks and have not noticed a difference on dark spots. Product is sticky at first, but does not stay sticky on skin.

I've been using this serum for about two weeks now, once every evening before bed. With just 3 drops per use, I was pleasantly surprised with the results. The serum doesn't leave your skin feeling greasy like some serums do. Instead, it creates a beautiful glow. My skin tone has evened out, no more patches of uneven colors. My skin looks radiant and hydrated. Overall, I love it and definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Skin feels awesome and great scent!
avis.texte: I love this stuff! My skin feels super soft and I see some of my spots lightening up. It smells like oranges and instantly brightens my morning. Would definitely buy again!

I have been using vitamin C serum on my face in the morning for years. I was given this free sample from No 7 and I expected it to be like the one I regularly use but it is much better! I really like it. It makes my skin noticeably glowy immediately after use and for the remainder of the day. I would definitely consider buying it again when it runs out. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: No7 is top of the line!
avis.texte: I am in love with this product! The No7 Rad Plus15 Percent VitC Concentrate is my new fave in my skincare routine. I have been using this for a little over 3 weeks and my skin has never looked better. I won't go a day without it!

No7 products are very affordable, there is light citrus scent in this bottle and Ilove it has 15% Vitamin C in this serum. I used once a day and it improved my uneven skin tone, I can see it brighten my dark spots in which it helps me with tired-looking skin. This is a nice vitamin C serum to stick with after using toner. I will repurchase it and recommend it to my friends and family.
Love this vitamin C serum. It has a pleasant smell (a little orange) that if perfect for the morning and the texture is also great for my skin. It's a serum but dries really light

This is truly a great serum, this is the second product of N°7 I've tried and like the previews one this one did not dissapoint, it leaves my skin feeling vdry soft and my complexion looks brighter, I love it.

I am loving this vitamin C serum. It kind of feels like a serum oil when I apply it. Super easy to spread and leaves my skin nice and dewy. It doesn't feel sticky or heavy on my skin. Layers well with other products
